text:
sam: Heads-up — deploy-bot aborted a canary publish in eu-west-1 for redwood/runtime. It flagged a provenance digest mismatch on the mirror. Anyone alive?

deploy-bot: automatic alert: publish_aborted; reason=provenance_digest_mismatch; image=redwood/runtime@sha256:abcd1234; mirrored_image=mirror.gcr.io/redwood/runtime@sha256:abcd5678; suggested_action=pinback

jess: on it. quick question — is this a signature mismatch or an attestation metadata drift?

sam: looks like metadata. I saw a KMS annotation change during last mirror maintenance.

angelo: inspecting mirror annotations now — mirror has "sig_kms: key-prod-2" while primary uses "key-prod-1". cosign/attestation will fail if signer key differs.

jess: ok. short plan: pin back to previous validated digest (sha256:1111aaaa) for canary, document in release notes, and follow up to fix mirror KMS. Anyone can push the pin?

linda: I can do a manual republish/pin to staging and then promote. deploy-bot accepts pinned digests if attestation verifies.

sam: action items — linda: manual republish & pin sha256:1111aaaa (ETA ~10m); jess: update release notes + incident entry (ETA ~20m); angelo: coordinate with mirrors team to rotate KMS or re-sign attestation (ETA 2h).

jess: draft release note: "Canary publish deferred in eu-west-1 due to mirrored attestation mismatch; temporary pin to previously validated digest applied. Root cause: mirror KMS annotation drift. Fix in progress." thoughts?

angelо: typo in my name above but ack — that note looks good. also add customer-facing blurb if any scheduled promotions will be delayed.

sam: good call. jess add that line. if republish fails, rollback criteria = hold all canaries and pause automated promotions. @deploy-bot can you add a hold tag to canary channel?

deploy-bot: applied tag "publish_hold" to canary group; automated promotions paused.

linda: starting republish command now:
```
gcrctl mirror push --source image=redwood/runtime@sha256:1111aaaa \\n  --target mirror.gcr.io/redwood/runtime \\n  --resign=false
```

linda: republish finished, attestation present and verified against key-prod-1, deploying pinned digest to staging then canary. deploy-bot accepted pinned digest and resumed canary promotion.

jess: updating release notes and CHANGES.md with the incident and pinback entry. will paste the final text here once done.

sam: thanks — keep updates in this thread. if mirrors team needs anything from infra (key rotation window), tag me. :thumbsup:
